controls.title: Information Security Risk Assessment
controls.description: Designate a qualified individual to oversee, implement, and enforce the information security program. Conduct periodic risk assessments to identify reasonably foreseeable internal and external risks to the security, confidentiality, and integrity of customer information that could result in the unauthorized disclosure, misuse, alteration, destruction, or other compromise of such information.
controls.supplemental_guidance: The 2021 FTC Safeguards Rule amendments require written risk assessments.
assessment_objectives: Verify risk assessment is conducted and documented

controls.title: Qualified Individual
controls.description: Designate a single qualified individual responsible for overseeing and implementing the information security program and enforcing the information security program.
controls.supplemental_guidance: May be an employee, affiliate, or service provider.

controls.title: Access Controls
controls.description: Implement and periodically review access controls, including technical and physical controls to authenticate and permit access only to authorized users and limit authorized users' access to the scope of their authorization, to protect against the unauthorized acquisition of customer information.
assessment_objectives: Verify access controls limit access to authorized users

controls.title: Data Inventory and Classification
controls.description: Identify and manage the data, personnel, devices, systems, and facilities that enable the organization to achieve business purposes in accordance with their relative importance to business objectives and the organization's risk strategy, including maintaining a complete and accurate inventory of all systems and assets.

controls.title: Encryption
controls.description: Protect by encryption all customer information held or transmitted by the financial institution both in transit over external networks and at rest. If encryption is infeasible, secure it using effective alternative compensating controls approved by the qualified individual.
controls.supplemental_guidance: 2021 amendment made encryption mandatory rather than optional.
assessment_objectives: Verify customer information is encrypted in transit and at rest

controls.title: Secure Development Practices
controls.description: Adopt secure development practices for in-house developed applications utilized by the financial institution and procedures for evaluating, assessing, or testing the security of externally developed applications utilized by the financial institution.
assessment_objectives: Verify secure development practices for applications

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Implement multi-factor authentication for any individual accessing any information system, unless the qualified individual has approved in writing the use of reasonably equivalent or more secure access controls.
assessment_objectives: Verify MFA is implemented for information system access

controls.title: Information Disposal
controls.description: Implement policies, procedures, and controls to securely dispose of customer information in any format no later than two years after the last date the information is used in connection with the provision of a product or service to the customer, unless retention is otherwise required by law or regulation.
assessment_objectives: Verify secure disposal of customer information

controls.title: Change Management
controls.description: Adopt procedures for change management to ensure that changes to information systems do not create vulnerabilities or degrade the security posture.

controls.title: Monitoring and Logging
controls.description: Implement policies, procedures, and controls designed to monitor and log the activity of authorized users and detect unauthorized access or use of, or tampering with, customer information by such users.
assessment_objectives: Verify monitoring and logging of user activity

controls.title: Security Awareness Training
controls.description: Provide personnel with security awareness training that is updated to reflect risks identified by the risk assessment, and verify that key information security personnel take steps to maintain current knowledge of changing information security threats and countermeasures.
assessment_objectives: Verify security awareness training is provided

controls.title: Service Provider Oversight
controls.description: Oversee service providers by taking reasonable steps to select and retain service providers that maintain appropriate safeguards for customer information, requiring service providers by contract to implement and maintain such safeguards, and periodically assessing service providers based on the risk they present and the continued adequacy of their safeguards.
assessment_objectives: Verify service provider oversight and contractual requirements

controls.title: Incident Response Plan
controls.description: Establish a written incident response plan designed to promptly respond to, and recover from, any security event materially affecting the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of customer information in the financial institution's control.
controls.supplemental_guidance: Plan must address: goals, internal processes, roles/responsibilities, communication, remediation, documentation, and post-incident evaluation.
assessment_objectives: Verify incident response plan exists and is documented

controls.title: Periodic Testing and Monitoring
controls.description: Regularly test or otherwise monitor the effectiveness of the safeguards' key controls, systems, and procedures, including those to detect actual and attempted attacks on, or intrusions into, information systems through continuous monitoring or periodic penetration testing and vulnerability assessments.
controls.supplemental_guidance: Annual penetration testing and semi-annual vulnerability assessments required.
assessment_objectives: Verify periodic testing of security controls

controls.title: Board Reporting
controls.description: The qualified individual shall report in writing, regularly and at least annually, to the board of directors or equivalent governing body. The report shall include the overall status of the information security program and the financial institution's compliance with the Safeguards Rule, material matters related to the program including risk assessment, risk management decisions, service provider arrangements, test results, security events and response, and recommendations for changes to the program.
assessment_objectives: Verify annual board reporting on information security program
